tour.weightsComposite: Raw — all the ingredients of the dish. Cooked — the weight after cooking: that's what you enter each time. The dish remembers the ingredients.
tour.weightsSimple: Dry — the weight before cooking. Cooked — how much you got after cooking: that's what you enter each time. The dish remembers the dry weight.
tour.tareTitle: What do you weigh it in?
tour.tareText: If it's in a pot, pick the pot here. We'll subtract the empty container's weight.
tour.barText: Drag the boundary on the bar — the shares are saved with this dish. Another person — + Name below.
tour.whoText: Type a name and confirm — one person at a time. We'll split the cooked dish equally; you can change the shares later.
tour.shelfText: Tap a name to open that dish. Search on the left finds your dishes and adds popular ones with their usual weight.

hintsOffDescription: Turn them back on in Settings
